request: reading from tag buffer U32 at offset

candidates.prompt: One SQUARE flat software icon on white for reading from a tag buffer a value of datatype U32. Across the TOP place exactly U32 in HUGE BOLD BLACK characters with large WHITE GAPS between each character. Capital I, if present, MUST have broad horizontal top and bottom bars, clearly different from digit 1. The exact label U32 must dominate the image and remain legible at 30x18 pixels. No other text, no shadows. Below the type show a large BLUE rectangular buffer and a bold ORANGE horizontal arrow pointing AWAY from the buffer. The arrow must clearly show data going out of the buffer. Center the entire design within the square.

signature.composition: Below the type show a large BLUE rectangular buffer and a bold ORANGE horizontal arrow pointing AWAY from the buffer. The arrow must clearly show data going out of the buffer.

30x18.evidence: U32 is distinguishable and the outgoing arrow is visible.

30x23.evidence: U, 3 and 2 are legible; the outward arrow survives.

29x29.evidence: U32 and the rectangular buffer and rightward arrow remain visible.

source.evidence: U32 appears above a rectangular buffer and rightward arrow, showing outward transfer.

16x16.evidence: The label and arrow remain recognizable with softened detail.
